title: The Mitten
author: Jan Brett

hero.name: Nicki's Mitten
hero.description: Large white knitted mitten lying in snow, the central object of the story — distinctive Jan Brett illustration style
hero.source_note: A white knitted mitten is the hero object; generic Boardmaker mitten icon should work well

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the animal (noun) or the verb 'to bear/carry'
ambiguous.reason: The bear is one of the animals that crawls into the mitten in the story

notes: The mitten itself is the iconic hero object — most students will recognise it from the cover. Mouse, hedgehog, and mole are already in aac_extras; sneeze is also in aac_extras and is a key story event (the bear's sneeze blows all the animals out). Consider swapping 'squeeze' for 'sneeze' since sneeze is already sourced and is the climactic action of the story — however 'squeeze' is also very relevant as the animals squeeze into the mitten. The mouse (not listed in fringe_11 to avoid duplication) is already available. Nicki and Baba (grandmother) are the two human characters; 'boy' covers Nicki and 'grandma' covers Baba. The remaining animals from the book — badger, wild boar/pig — are lower priority and did not make the top 11. 'cold' is included as a key descriptive concept central to the winter setting.
